text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув put her best foot forward in
the
Osaka Hai. Afterwards, in the
waiting room...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This race was another step towards
taking on
Suzuka. The question is, where
will she be next?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Someone of Сайленс Судзука's talents
would
probably run in...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Agreed. There's no doubt in my mind
that's where
she'll choose to run next.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list:
We'll do even better in the Takarazuka Kinen
than today.

text_block_list.text:
That we will. I'll definitely defeat
Suzuka.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув begins to pack her things,
but
something seems off about her...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
